title: Entropy News: Reproducible Estimation and Decomposition of Financial-News Entropy
description:
Entropy News is research software for reproducible estimation of time-varying information content in financial news using rolling neural language models. It implements a strict methodological reproduction of the entropy construction in Glasserman, Mamaysky, and Qin's New News is Bad News, including the 12-month entropy change and its ENT_NEWS and ENT_MODEL decomposition.

The reproduction path fixes the reported 100-dimensional GloVe input, 16-unit LSTM state, 10,000-class predictive vocabulary, monthly warm-start updating scheme, article-level entropy aggregation, and lagged-model comparison required to reproduce the paper's reported decomposition. It also records model, vocabulary, environment, and corpus-contract metadata so that the computational specification can be audited independently.

The software distinguishes methodological reproduction from empirical replication. It can validate an explicit Reuters-style corpus contract, but it neither supplies nor certifies proprietary Reuters data. An empirical replication therefore requires independently obtained and documented source data satisfying the stated corpus conditions. Additional architectures and engineering utilities are provided outside the strict reproduction path and are not part of the paper-faithful specification.
